keys.note: hand at rest; outbound starts 3f after the eyes drop (f15)
arm-only: the wrist hugs the curve of the bump
outbound rides up over the curve of the bump
caress extreme (wrist turns at f87), lands at the end of the exhale; head/neck keys land early (measured local peaks f79/f79) so the head tip turns back at f83, ahead of the hand
release: lower hand path, fingers trailing; neck lengthens so the head lifts away on the next inhale
release lands: wrist 2 deg and head 1.2 deg past rest, both ease back
wrist settles back; moving hold across the loop seam to 0.6 s

events.note: as the head starts back; hides the gaze returning; opens over 8f so tender eyes don't snap wide

breath.note: phase0: belly inhale peak at 1.0 s (f30), belly exhale ends f77 (chest +3f, head +7f), so the caress extreme sits in the breath pause and the head lifts away on the next inhale; f0 is a moving hold mid-inhale. Gains exaggerated past the pack (chest 2.6%) for phone legibility (critic R1-R2)
